decisions.rationale: ROOT independently confirmed the executable problem, with a stronger Windows-specific observation than the review wording: the packaged source seed files were writable (mode 0666), while Git linked-worktree checkout did not preserve the target's read-only protection. The prior snapshot therefore either rejected startup for the wrong reason or failed to establish a protected linked-worktree boundary. The localized repair at f571c5ed binds the exact five content hashes, applies read-only mode only after worktree creation, and rechecks that boundary before launch, at worker reap, and at assignment acceptance. This functionality break materially outweighs the small implementation and verification risk; no broader isolation feature is justified.
decisions.smallest_fix: Keep source seed identity content-only; after git worktree add mark exactly the five protected seed files read-only, then require their exact hashes and non-writable mode before launch, at reap, and at acceptance.
